question: In a certain code language, PISTA is written as OGPPV. How will ALMOND be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/678b4f865b23bcd12856819c9b0dd21a85252bab0361f2131a9a96a2aaf53b68.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, PISTA is coded as OGPPV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/695c05956b0eadc0a92f2c268c06c17a1bd9afcc734cf41df6411c24f5c03064.png] 

Similarly, for **ALMOND**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce84e0bddc39e8ceb55f68de9f4f363fa64c1b4f587051b5ec9aeb25a38612c3.png] 

So, ALMOND will be coded as ZJJKIX.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 2".**
